### CVE-2026-76298 — Use of Hard-coded Cryptographic Key in the PostgreSQL Sidecar Service in Splunk Enterprise
- Assigner: cisco | Published: 2026-10-21 | Updated: 2026-10-23 | Max CVSS: 8.8
- CWE: CWE-321 The use of a hard-coded cryptographic key significantly increases the possibility that encrypted data may be recovered.
- CVSS 3.1 (cna): 8.8 HIGH `CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:L/PR:L/UI:N/S:U/C:H/I:H/A:H`
- SSVC (CISA-ADP): Exploitation=none, Automatable=no, Technical Impact=total

In Splunk Enterprise versions below 10.4.4 and 10.2.8, a user who does not hold the "admin" or "power" Splunk roles could derive the PostgreSQL sidecar database superuser password and run arbitrary operating system commands as the user account running Splunk Enterprise on search head cluster members.
The vulnerability is possible because the PostgreSQL sidecar service derives a privileged database password from the search head cluster identifier that appears in search job logs.
For more information see About configuring role-based user access (https://help.splunk.com/en/splunk-enterprise/administer/manage-users-and-security/10.2/manage-splunk-platform-users-and-roles/about-configuring-role-based-user-access), server.conf (https://help.splunk.com/en/splunk-enterprise/administer/admin-manual/10.2/configuration-file-reference/10.2.0-configuration-file-reference/server.conf), and Sidecar configuration settings (https://help.splunk.com/en/splunk-enterprise/administer/admin-manual/10.4/splunk-sidecars/sidecar-configuration-settings) in the Splunk documentation.

**workarounds:** If you cannot immediately upgrade to a fixed version, turn off the PostgreSQL sidecar service.
Add the following stanza in the `server.conf` configuration file: `[postgres]` `disabled = true`. Restart Splunk Enterprise for the change to take effect.
Do not apply this workaround if you use Edge Processor, OpAmp, or SPL2 data pipelines on the instance. Turning off PostgreSQL breaks these features and can cascade to dependent sidecar processes. Core search, indexing, and dashboard functionality are not affected.
For more information see [Sidecar configuration settings](https://help.splunk.com/en/splunk-enterprise/administer/admin-manual/10.4/splunk-sidecars/sidecar-configuration-settings) in the Splunk documentation.

**solutions:** Upgrade Splunk Enterprise to versions 10.4.4, 10.2.8, 10.0.11, and 9.4.16 or higher.

Affected:
- Splunk / Splunk Enterprise: affected 10.4 <10.4.4 (custom); affected 10.2 <10.2.8 (custom)

Credits: Ofir Alkoby, Security Researcher, a.security

References:
- https://advisory.splunk.com/advisories/SVD-2026-1007

### CVE-2026-76306 — Information Disclosure through REST API Query Filters in Splunk SOAR
- Assigner: cisco | Published: 2026-10-21 | Updated: 2026-11-02 | Max CVSS: 7.5
- CWE: CWE-200 The product exposes sensitive information to an actor that is not explicitly authorized to have access to that information.
- CVSS 3.1 (cna): 7.5 HIGH `CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:H/PR:L/UI:N/S:U/C:H/I:H/A:H`
- SSVC (CISA-ADP): Exploitation=none, Automatable=no, Technical Impact=total

In Splunk SOAR versions below 8.7.0, a user that has the "Observer" role could use query filters in the Representational State Transfer (REST) API to infer password hashes and authorization tokens for other users.

**solutions:** Upgrade Splunk SOAR to version 8.7.0 or higher.

### CVE-2026-76310 — Improper Access Control through Embedded Report REST API Requests in Splunk Enterprise
- Assigner: cisco | Published: 2026-08-19 | Updated: 2026-08-27 | Max CVSS: 9.4
- CWE: CWE-284 The software does not restrict or incorrectly restricts access to a resource from an unauthorized actor.
- CVSS 3.1 (cna): 9.4 CRITICAL `CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:L/PR:N/UI:N/S:U/C:H/I:H/A:L`
- SSVC (CISA-ADP): Exploitation=none, Automatable=yes, Technical Impact=total

In Splunk Enterprise versions below 10.4.2, 10.2.6, 10.0.9, and 9.4.14, an unauthenticated user who has an embedded report token could download the associated search job dispatch archive, recover session material, and use it to access all relevant data available to the report owner and affect system integrity, including by performing administrative actions when the owner holds the "admin" Splunk role. The vulnerability is possible because embedded report access does not block Representational State Transfer (REST) API dispatch archive download requests. For more information see Additional configuration for embedded reports (https://help.splunk.com/en/splunk-enterprise/create-dashboards-and-reports/reporting-manual/9.1/report-management/additional-configuration-for-embedded-reports) and About configuring role-based user access (https://help.splunk.com/en/splunk-enterprise/administer/manage-users-and-security/10.4/manage-splunk-platform-users-and-roles/about-configuring-role-based-user-access) in the Splunk documentation.

**workarounds:** Turn off report embedding globally by setting allowEmbedTokenAuth = false in the server.conf configuration file if you do not use embedded report functionality. For more information see [Additional configuration for embedded reports](https://help.splunk.com/en/splunk-enterprise/create-dashboards-and-reports/reporting-manual/9.1/report-management/additional-configuration-for-embedded-reports) in the Splunk documentation.

**solutions:** Upgrade Splunk Enterprise to versions 10.4.2, 10.2.6, 10.0.9, and 9.4.14, or higher.

Affected:

The vulnerability is possible because Splunk Web evaluates manager Extensible Markup Language expressions without sufficient input restrictions, and the associated configuration route does not require the capability expected for manager configuration changes. For more information see About configuration files (https://help.splunk.com/en/data-management/splunk-enterprise-admin-manual/10.4/administer-splunk-enterprise-with-configuration-files/about-configuration-files) in the Splunk documentation.

**solutions:** Upgrade Splunk Enterprise to versions 10.4.2, 10.2.6, 10.0.9, and 9.4.14, or higher.

### CVE-2026-76338 — Improper Authentication through REST API Distributed Search Token Requests in Splunk Enterprise
- Assigner: cisco | Published: 2026-08-19 | Updated: 2026-08-27 | Max CVSS: 8.1
- CWE: CWE-287 When an actor claims to have a given identity, the software does not prove or insufficiently proves that the claim is correct.
- CVSS 3.1 (cna): 8.1 HIGH `CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:H/PR:N/UI:N/S:U/C:H/I:H/A:H`
- SSVC (CISA-ADP): Exploitation=none, Automatable=no, Technical Impact=total

In Splunk Enterprise versions below 10.4.2, 10.2.6, 10.0.9, and 9.4.14, an unauthenticated user who has access to a trusted distributed search private key could forge an administrative session token, access all relevant data, affect system integrity, and disrupt service availability. The vulnerability is possible because the distributed search authentication token endpoint does not require a signed request to identify a configured search peer, allowing the request to fall back to shared local key material. For more information see About distributed search (https://help.splunk.com/en/splunk-enterprise/administer/distributed-search/10.4/overview-of-distributed-search/about-distributed-search) and authentication.conf (https://help.splunk.com/en/splunk-enterprise/administer/admin-manual/10.4/configuration-file-reference/10.4.2-configuration-file-reference/authentication.conf) in Splunk documentation.

**workarounds:** Turn off legacy distributed search token fallback by setting strictPeerNameValidation = true in the authentication.conf configuration file if you do not use distributed search peers that omit peername. Restart Splunk Enterprise on every node in the distributed environment after applying the setting. For more information see [authentication.conf](https://help.splunk.com/en/splunk-enterprise/administer/admin-manual/10.4/configuration-file-reference/10.4.2-configuration-file-reference/authentication.conf) in the Splunk documentation.

**solutions:** Upgrade Splunk Enterprise to versions 10.4.2, 10.2.6, 10.0.9, and 9.4.14, or higher.

Set `strictPeerNameValidation = true` in `authentication.conf` on every distributed node, then restart Splunk Enterprise.

Affected:
- Splunk / Splunk Enterprise: affected 10.4 <10.4.2 (custom); affected 10.2 <10.2.6 (custom); affected 10.0 <10.0.9 (custom); affected 9.4 <9.4.14 (custom)

References:
- https://advisory.splunk.com/advisories/SVD-2026-0801

### CVE-2026-76350 — Improper Privilege Management through PDF Attachments for Email Alert Actions in Splunk Enterprise
- Assigner: cisco | Published: 2026-08-19 | Updated: 2026-08-21 | Max CVSS: 8.8
- CWE: CWE-269 The software does not properly assign, modify, track, or check privileges for an actor, creating an unintended sphere of control for that actor.
- CVSS 3.1 (cna): 8.8 HIGH `CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:L/PR:L/UI:N/S:U/C:H/I:H/A:H`
- SSVC (CISA-ADP): Exploitation=none, Automatable=no, Technical Impact=total

In Splunk Enterprise versions below 10.4.2, 10.2.6, 10.0.9, and 9.4.14, a user that holds a role with the schedule_search capability could configure Portable Document Format (PDF) attachments in the email alert action workflow. When the email alert action runs, it could execute arbitrary Search Processing Language (SPL) commands with system-level privileges, expose all relevant data, and affect system integrity and availability on the search head. ### CVE-2026-76351 — Server-Side Request Forgery (SSRF) through the Report Notification REST API in Splunk Secure Gateway
- Assigner: cisco | Published: 2026-08-19 | Updated: 2026-08-21 | Max CVSS: 8.8
- CWE: CWE-918 The web server receives a URL or similar request from an upstream component and retrieves the contents of this URL, but it does not sufficiently ensure that the request is being sent to the expected destination.
- CVSS 3.1 (cna): 8.8 HIGH `CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:L/PR:L/UI:N/S:U/C:H/I:H/A:H`
- SSVC (CISA-ADP): Exploitation=none, Automatable=no, Technical Impact=total

In Splunk Enterprise versions below 10.4.2, 10.2.6, 10.0.9, and 9.4.14, and Splunk Secure Gateway versions below 3.10.9, 3.9.23, and 3.8.70, a user who does not hold the "admin" or "power" Splunk roles could use crafted report notification data to cause Splunk Secure Gateway to send a request to the Splunk Enterprise Representational State Transfer (REST) API using a system-level session token and modify the Splunk platform configuration. The user could then obtain a session token without a password and use it to access all relevant data and affect system integrity. The vulnerability is possible because Splunk Secure Gateway does not validate decoded report notification identifiers before using them to construct requests to the Splunk Enterprise REST API.

**workarounds:** Turn off or remove the Splunk Secure Gateway app. See [Manage app and add-on objects](https://help.splunk.com/en/splunk-enterprise/administer/admin-manual/10.2/meet-splunk-apps/manage-app-and-add-on-objects) in the Splunk documentation. Note: Splunk Mobile, Spacebridge, and Mission Control rely on functionality in the Splunk Secure Gateway app. If you do not use any of these apps, features, or functionality, as a potential mitigation, you may turn off or remove the app.

**solutions:** Upgrade Splunk Enterprise to versions 10.4.2, 10.2.6, 10.0.9, and 9.4.14, or higher.

Affected:
- Splunk / Splunk Enterprise: affected 10.4 <10.4.2 (custom); affected 10.2 <10.2.6 (custom); affected 10.0 <10.0.9 (custom); affected 9.4 <9.4.14 (custom)
- Splunk / Splunk Secure Gateway: affected 3.10 <3.10.9 (custom); affected 3.9 <3.9.23 (custom); affected 3.8 <3.8.70 (custom)

### CVE-2026-76352 — Improper Authorization through the REST API in Splunk Enterprise
- Assigner: cisco | Published: 2026-08-19 | Updated: 2026-08-21 | Max CVSS: 8.8
- CWE: CWE-285 The software does not perform or incorrectly performs an authorization check when an actor attempts to access a resource or perform an action.
- CVSS 3.1 (cna): 8.8 HIGH `CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:L/PR:L/UI:N/S:U/C:H/I:H/A:H`
- SSVC (CISA-ADP): Exploitation=none, Automatable=no, Technical Impact=total

In Splunk Enterprise versions below 10.4.2, 10.2.6, 10.0.9, and 9.4.14, a user who does not hold the "admin" or "power" Splunk roles could create or modify a scripted lookup through generic configuration endpoints and run an installed lookup script with the permissions of the user account running Splunk Enterprise, which could allow for access to all relevant data and affect system integrity and availability. The vulnerability is possible because the generic transforms configuration endpoints do not enforce the capabilities required to create or edit external lookup definitions. For more information see Define roles on the Splunk platform with capabilities (https://help.splunk.com/en/splunk-enterprise/administer/manage-users-and-security/10.2/manage-splunk-platform-users-and-roles/define-roles-on-the-splunk-platform-with-capabilities) and limits.conf (https://help.splunk.com/en/splunk-enterprise/administer/admin-manual/10.4/configuration-file-reference/10.4.2-configuration-file-reference/limits.conf) in the Splunk documentation.

**solutions:** Upgrade Splunk Enterprise to versions 10.4.2, 10.2.6, 10.0.9, and 9.4.14, or higher.

After upgrading, set `scripted_lookup_raw_write_enforcement = block` in the `limits.conf` configuration file under `[lookup]`, and then restart Splunk Enterprise.

- Splunk / Splunk Enterprise: affected 10.4 <10.4.2 (custom); affected 10.2 <10.2.6 (custom); affected 10.0 <10.0.9 (custom); affected 9.4 <9.4.14 (custom)

### CVE-2026-76391 — Improper Privilege Management through Agent Run History in Splunk AI Toolkit
- Assigner: cisco | Published: 2026-08-19 | Updated: 2026-08-26 | Max CVSS: 8.3
- CWE: CWE-863 The software performs an authorization check when an actor attempts to access a resource or perform an action, but it does not correctly perform the check. This allows attackers to bypass intended access restrictions.

- SSVC (CISA-ADP): Exploitation=none, Automatable=no, Technical Impact=total

In Splunk AI Toolkit versions below 6.0.0, a user who does not hold the "admin" or "power" Splunk roles could run searches with system-level privileges, access all relevant data, affect system integrity, and read or delete search jobs belonging to other users through Agent Run History. The improper privilege management is possible because the Agent Run History handler replaces the calling user session key with a system authentication token before it performs search operations. For more information see AI Toolkit Agent Launchpad (https://help.splunk.com/en/splunk-enterprise/apply-machine-learning/use-ai-toolkit/6.0.0/ai-toolkit-connections-containers-and-agents/ai-toolkit-agent-launchpad) in the Splunk documentation.

**workarounds:** Turn off or remove the Splunk AI Toolkit app. For more information see [Manage app and add-on objects](https://help.splunk.com/en/splunk-enterprise/administer/admin-manual/10.2/meet-splunk-apps/manage-app-and-add-on-objects) in the Splunk documentation. Note: turning off Splunk AI Toolkit turns off AI Toolkit Search Processing Language (SPL) commands and model operations. Note: turning off Splunk AI Toolkit turns off AI Toolkit Search Processing Language (SPL) commands and model operations. Splunk App for Data Science and Deep Learning and custom search commands that depend on AI Toolkit models or APIs might stop functioning. Unrelated Splunk custom search commands are not affected. For more information see [Troubleshoot the Splunk Machine Learning Toolkit](https://help.splunk.com/en/splunk-cloud-platform/apply-machine-learning/use-ai-toolkit/5.5.0/troubleshooting-mltk/troubleshoot-the-splunk-machine-learning-toolkit) and [DSDL install/version dependencies](https://help.splunk.com/en/splunk-enterprise/apply-machine-learning/splunk-app-for-data-science-and-deep-learning/5.1/install-and-configure-the-splunk-app-for-data-science-and-deep-learning/install-or-upgrade-the-splunk-app-for-data-science-and-deep-learning) in the Splunk documentation.

### CVE-2026-76397 — Improper Access Control in Experiment History through the REST API in Splunk AI Toolkit
- Assigner: cisco | Published: 2026-08-19 | Updated: 2026-08-20 | Max CVSS: 8.1
- CWE: CWE-639 The system's authorization functionality does not prevent one user from gaining access to another user's data or record by modifying the key value identifying the data.
- CVSS 3.1 (cna): 8.1 HIGH `CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:L/PR:L/UI:N/S:U/C:H/I:H/A:N`
- SSVC (CISA-ADP): Exploitation=none, Automatable=no, Technical Impact=partial

In Splunk AI Toolkit versions below 6.0.0, a user who holds the "power" Splunk role could access and delete all relevant data in experiment history, including data associated with other users. For more information see Experiment Assistants (https://help.splunk.com/en/splunk-cloud-platform/apply-machine-learning/use-ai-toolkit/5.6.4/experiment-assistants) in the Splunk documentation.

### CVE-2026-76399 — Incorrect Permission Assignment for Scheduled Searches in Splunk AI Toolkit
- Assigner: cisco | Published: 2026-08-19 | Updated: 2026-08-26 | Max CVSS: 8.1
- CWE: CWE-732 The product specifies permissions for a security-critical resource in a way that allows that resource to be read or modified by unintended actors.
- CVSS 3.1 (cna): 8.1 HIGH `CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:L/PR:L/UI:N/S:U/C:H/I:H/A:N`
- SSVC (CISA-ADP): Exploitation=none, Automatable=no, Technical Impact=total

In Splunk AI Toolkit versions below 6.0.1, a user who holds the "power" Splunk role could modify app-provided scheduled searches to run arbitrary Search Processing Language (SPL) using the permissions of the search owner, which could allow access to all relevant data and affect system integrity. The vulnerability is possible because Splunk AI Toolkit gives the "power" Splunk role permission to modify scheduled searches that run using the permissions of the search owner.

**workarounds:** Turn off or remove the Splunk AI Toolkit app. For more information see [Manage app and add-on objects](https://help.splunk.com/en/splunk-enterprise/administer/admin-manual/10.2/meet-splunk-apps/manage-app-and-add-on-objects) in the Splunk documentation.

### CVE-2026-76402 — Server-Side Request Forgery (SSRF) through the REST API in Splunk Connect for Kafka
- Assigner: cisco | Published: 2026-08-19 | Updated: 2026-08-20 | Max CVSS: 8.2
- CWE: CWE-918 The web server receives a URL or similar request from an upstream component and retrieves the contents of this URL, but it does not sufficiently ensure that the request is being sent to the expected destination.
- CVSS 3.1 (cna): 8.2 HIGH `CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:L/PR:N/UI:N/S:U/C:H/I:L/A:N`
- SSVC (CISA-ADP): Exploitation=none, Automatable=yes, Technical Impact=partial

In Splunk Connect for Kafka versions below 2.2.7, an unauthenticated user who can reach the Kafka Connect Representational State Transfer (REST) API could configure a non-secure Hypertext Transfer Protocol (HTTP) Event Collector endpoint in Splunk Enterprise that causes the connector to send authentication credentials to an attacker-controlled server, allowing for exposure of credentials that compromise all relevant data sent through the connector and limited alteration of event delivery. The vulnerability is possible because HTTP Event Collector endpoint validation does not require secure transport by default. For more information see Install Splunk Connect for Kafka (https://help.splunk.com/en/data-management/integrate-data-with-add-ons/splunk-connect-for-kafka/2.2/install/install-splunk-connect-for-kafka), Data ingestion parameters for Splunk Connect for Kafka (https://help.splunk.com/en/data-management/integrate-data-with-add-ons/splunk-connect-for-kafka/2.2/overview/data-ingestion-parameters-for-splunk-connect-for-kafka), and Set up and use HTTP Event Collector with configuration files (https://help.splunk.com/en/splunk-enterprise/get-data-in/get-started-with-getting-data-in/9.4/get-data-with-http-event-collector/set-up-and-use-http-event-collector-with-configuration-files) in the Splunk documentation.

**workarounds:** Restrict access to the Kafka Connect Representational State Transfer (REST) API to trusted administrative hosts and networks. Keep secure endpoint enforcement turned on so connector configuration requires secure transport for HTTP Event Collector endpoints. If you do not require a secure HTTP Event Collector transport, restrict that traffic to a trusted private network in addition to restricting Kafka Connect REST API access. For more information see [Data ingestion parameters for Splunk Connect for Kafka](https://help.splunk.com/en/data-management/integrate-data-with-add-ons/splunk-connect-for-kafka/2.2/overview/data-ingestion-parameters-for-splunk-connect-for-kafka) and [Set up and use HTTP Event Collector with configuration files](https://help.splunk.com/en/splunk-enterprise/get-data-in/get-started-with-getting-data-in/9.4/get-data-with-http-event-collector/set-up-and-use-http-event-collector-with-configuration-files) in the Splunk documentation.

**solutions:** Upgrade each affected Splunk app or add-on to the applicable fixed version listed in Product Status.

Affected:
- Splunk / Splunk Connect for Kafka: affected 2.2 <2.2.7 (custom)

Credits: Gabriel Nitu, Splunk

References:
- https://advisory.splunk.com/advisories/SVD-2026-0808

### CVE-2026-76403 — Improper Certificate Validation through HTTP Event Collector Kerberos Authentication in Splunk Connect for Kafka

### CVE-2026-76412 — Cisco Secure Firewall Management Center Software Authenticated Privilege Escalation to Root Vulnerability
- Assigner: cisco | Published: 2026-09-16 | Updated: 2026-09-17 | Max CVSS: 8.5
- CWE: CWE-264 Permissions, Privileges, and Access Control
- CVSS 3.1 (cna): 8.5 HIGH `CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:H/PR:L/UI:N/S:C/C:H/I:H/A:H`
- SSVC (CISA-ADP): Exploitation=none, Automatable=no, Technical Impact=total

A vulnerability in the remote diagnostics debugger of Cisco Secure FMC Software could allow an authenticated, remote attacker to enable the remote diagnostics debugger service.

This vulnerability is due to an error when checking the privilege level of a user who is invoking remote diagnostics. An attacker could exploit this vulnerability by authenticating to the device, either through the web-based management interface or the REST API, and using the remote diagnostics debugger to grant a user elevated privileges. A successful exploit could allow the attacker to elevate privileges to root.
Notes:

To exploit this vulnerability, the attacker must have valid user credentials on the affected device.
The CVSSv3.1 Attack Complexity is High due to the multistage process required to fully exploit this vulnerability.

**exploits:** The Cisco Product Security Incident Response Team (PSIRT) is not aware of any public announcements or malicious use of the vulnerabilities that are described in this advisory.

### CVE-2026-76413 — Cisco Secure Firewall Management Center Software Single Sign-On Token Forgery of Administrator Account Vulnerability
- Assigner: cisco | Published: 2026-09-16 | Updated: 2026-09-17 | Max CVSS: 8.2
- CWE: CWE-1259 Improper Restriction of Security Token Assignment
- CVSS 3.1 (cna): 8.2 HIGH `CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:L/PR:N/UI:N/S:U/C:N/I:L/A:H`
- SSVC (CISA-ADP): Exploitation=none, Automatable=yes, Technical Impact=partial

A vulnerability in Cisco Adaptive Security Device Manager (ASDM) single sign-on (SSO) handler for Cisco Secure FMC Software could allow an unauthenticated, remote attacker to log in as the Cisco ASDM administrator user.

This vulnerability is due to improper management of the Cisco ASDM SSO token. An attacker could exploit this vulnerability by performing session token forgery techniques. A vulnerability in the Cisco Smart Licensing Utility API of Cisco License On-Prem, formerly Cisco Smart Software Manager On-Prem (SSM On-Prem), could allow an unauthenticated, remote attacker to write arbitrary files to the system or cause a DoS condition on an affected application.

### CVE-2026-76460 — Cisco Identity Services Engine Authentication Bypass Vulnerability
- Assigner: cisco | Published: 2026-09-16 | Updated: 2026-10-07 | Max CVSS: 10
- CWE: CWE-648 Incorrect Use of Privileged APIs
- CVSS 3.1 (cna): 10 CRITICAL `CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:L/PR:N/UI:N/S:C/C:H/I:H/A:H`
- SSVC (CISA-ADP): Exploitation=active, Automatable=yes, Technical Impact=total
- **CISA KEV**: added 2026-09-16, ransomware=Unknown — Cisco Identity Services Engine Incorrect Use of Privileged APIs Vulnerability

A vulnerability in an API of Cisco Identity Services Engine (ISE) could allow an unauthenticated, remote attacker to bypass authentication.

This vulnerability is due to insufficient authentication control on an API endpoint. An attacker could exploit this vulnerability by sending a crafted request to an affected API endpoint. A successful exploit could allow the attacker to gain unauthorized access to the affected device by bypassing the web-based management interface.

**exploits:** The Cisco PSIRT is aware of active exploitation of this vulnerability. Cisco strongly recommends that customers upgrade to a fixed software release to remediate this vulnerability.

### CVE-2026-76461 — Cisco Secure Email Gateway SQL Injection Vulnerability
- Assigner: cisco | Published: 2026-09-14 | Updated: 2026-09-18 | Max CVSS: 9.8
- CWE: CWE-89 Improper Neutralization of Special Elements used in an SQL Command ('SQL Injection')
- CVSS 3.1 (cna): 9.8 CRITICAL `CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:L/PR:N/UI:N/S:U/C:H/I:H/A:H`
- SSVC (CISA-ADP): Exploitation=active, Automatable=yes, Technical Impact=total
- **CISA KEV**: added 2026-09-14, ransomware=Unknown — Cisco Secure Email Gateway SQL Injection Vulnerability

A vulnerability in the email parsing of Cisco AsyncOS Software for Cisco Secure Email Gateway could allow an unauthenticated, remote attacker to execute arbitrary commands with root privileges on the underlying operating system.

This vulnerability is due to insufficient validation in the email parsing logic. An attacker could exploit this vulnerability by sending a crafted email message that contains malicious SQL statements through an affected device. A successful exploit could allow the attacker to execute arbitrary SQL statements, leading to command execution with root privileges on the underlying operating system.

**exploits:** In September 2026, the Cisco PSIRT became aware of active exploitation of this vulnerability.

### CVE-2026-76465 — Cisco Nexus 3000 and 9000 Series Switches MPLS OAM Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
- Assigner: cisco | Published: 2026-10-07 | Updated: 2026-10-08 | Max CVSS: 9.8
- CWE: CWE-590 Free of Memory not on the Heap
- CVSS 3.1 (cna): 9.8 CRITICAL `CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:L/PR:N/UI:N/S:U/C:H/I:H/A:H`
- SSVC (CISA-ADP): Exploitation=none, Automatable=yes, Technical Impact=total

A vulnerability in the MPLS Operation, Administration, and Maintenance (OAM) feature of Cisco NX-OS Software for Cisco Nexus 3000 Series Switches and Cisco Nexus 9000 Series Switches could allow an unauthenticated, remote attacker to execute arbitrary code with&nbsp;root privileges or cause a denial of service (DoS) condition on an affected device.

This vulnerability is due to improper validation when an affected device is processing an MPLS echo-request packet. An attacker could exploit this vulnerability by sending a crafted MPLS echo-request to an IP address on an affected device. A successful exploit could allow the attacker to execute arbitrary code with&nbsp;root privileges and could cause process crashes, which could result in a device reload and a DoS condition.

**exploits:** The Cisco Product Security Incident Response Team (PSIRT) is not aware of any public announcements or malicious use of the vulnerability that is described in this advisory.

### CVE-2026-76466 — Cisco Expressway Series Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
- Assigner: cisco | Published: 2026-10-21 | Updated: 2026-10-22 | Max CVSS: 9.8
- CWE: CWE-798 Use of Hard-coded Credentials
- CVSS 3.1 (cna): 9.8 CRITICAL `CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:L/PR:N/UI:N/S:U/C:H/I:H/A:H`
- SSVC (CISA-ADP): Exploitation=none, Automatable=yes, Technical Impact=total

A vulnerability in the database service feature of Cisco Expressway Series could allow an unauthenticated, remote attacker with network access to a Cisco Expressway device to execute arbitrary operating system commands as&nbsp;root.

This vulnerability is due to the use of persistent cookies. Additionally, there is insufficient validation of client certificates when the TLS Verify Mode is set to Enabled for clustering, which means that client certificates are not validated. An attacker with possession of the cookies could exploit this vulnerability by connecting to the database service and invoking specific remote procedure call (RPC) commands. A successful exploit could allow the attacker to execute arbitrary commands as root on the underlying operating system of an affected device.
Note: Cisco Expressway Series refers to Cisco Expressway Core (Expressway-C) devices and Cisco Expressway Edge (Expressway-E) devices.

**exploits:** The Cisco PSIRT is not aware of any public announcements or malicious use of the vulnerability that is described in this advisory.

Affected:
- Cisco / Cisco TelePresence Video Communication Server (VCS) Expressway: affected X8.11.2; affected X8.6; affected X8.11.3; affected X8.2.2; affected X8.8.3; affected X8.11.0; affected X12.5.2; affected X8.1.1; affected X8.9; affected X12.5.1; affected X12.5.6; affected X8.7.3; affected X12.6.0; affected X8.11.1; affected X8.5 …(+79 more in JSONL)

A vulnerability in the NX-API feature of Cisco NX-OS Software could allow an unauthenticated, remote attacker to execute arbitrary code with root privileges or cause a denial of service (DoS) condition on an affected device.&nbsp;

### CVE-2026-76485 — Cisco Nexus 3000 and 9000 Series Switches VXLAN OAM (NGOAM) Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
- Assigner: cisco | Published: 2026-10-07 | Updated: 2026-10-08 | Max CVSS: 9.8
- CWE: CWE-121 Stack-based Buffer Overflow
- CVSS 3.1 (cna): 9.8 CRITICAL `CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:L/PR:N/UI:N/S:U/C:H/I:H/A:H`
- SSVC (CISA-ADP): Exploitation=none, Automatable=yes, Technical Impact=total

A vulnerability in the VXLAN Operation, Administration, and Maintenance (OAM) feature of Cisco NX-OS Software, known as NGOAM, could allow an unauthenticated, remote attacker to execute arbitrary code with root privileges or cause a Denial-of-Service (DoS) on an affected device.

This vulnerability is due to improper input validation of IP traffic when the NGOAM feature is enabled. An attacker could exploit this vulnerability by sending crafted packets to an IP interface on an affected device. A successful exploit could allow the attacker to execute arbitrary code with root privileges and could cause process crashes resulting in a reload and DoS condition.

**exploits:** The Cisco Product Security Incident Response Team (PSIRT) is not aware of any public announcements or malicious use of the vulnerabilities that are described in this advisory.

Affected:
- Cisco / Cisco NX-OS Software: affected 9.2(3); affected 9.2(2v); affected 9.2(1); affected 9.2(2t); affected 9.2(3y); affected 9.3(2); affected 9.2(4); affected 9.3(1); affected 9.3(1z); affected 9.2(2); affected 9.3(3); affected 9.3(4); affected 9.3(5); affected 9.3(6); affected 9.3(5w) …(+58 more in JSONL)

### CVE-2026-76501 — Cisco Nexus 9000 Series Switches SRv6 OAM (NGOAM) Remote Code Execution Vulnerability

A vulnerability in the Segment Routing over IPv6 (SRv6) Operation, Administration, and Maintenance (OAM) feature of Cisco NX-OS Software, known as NGOAM, could allow an unauthenticated, remote attacker to execute arbitrary code with root privileges or cause a denial of service (DoS) on an affected device.

This vulnerability is due to improper input validation of IP traffic when the NGOAM and SRv6 features are enabled. An attacker could exploit this vulnerability by sending crafted packets to an IP interface on an affected device. A successful exploit could allow the attacker to execute arbitrary code with root privileges and could cause process crashes resulting in a reload and DoS condition.

A successful exploit could allow the attacker to bypass authentication and gain access to the API as the admin user.

### CVE-2026-76505 — Cisco IOS XR Software for ASR 9000 Series Routers IPv4 Unicast Packets Denial of Service Vulnerability
- Assigner: cisco | Published: 2026-10-21 | Updated: 2026-10-22 | Max CVSS: 7.5
- CWE: CWE-20 Improper Input Validation
- CVSS 3.1 (cna): 7.5 HIGH `CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:L/PR:N/UI:N/S:U/C:N/I:N/A:H`
- SSVC (CISA-ADP): Exploitation=none, Automatable=yes, Technical Impact=partial

A vulnerability in the IPv4 packet processing functionality of Cisco IOS XR Software that affects Cisco ASR 9000 and 9900 Series Aggregation Services Routers as well as Cisco ASR 9902 and 9903 Compact High-Performance Routers could allow an unauthenticated, remote attacker to cause network processor (NP) errors, resulting in a line card reset or shutdown and a denial of service (DoS) condition.&nbsp;

This vulnerability is due to the incorrect handling of crafted IPv4 packets that are received on an affected line card interface and processed as for-us traffic. The issue can result in an NP reset, causing traffic loss on the affected line card while it recovers. Under repeated reset conditions, the network processor may enter a persistent shutdown state, in which case an explicit line card reload may be required to restore traffic.
The vulnerability is within the IPv4 packet-processing path. Transit IPv4 traffic does not trigger this issue and IPv6 traffic cannot trigger it.

**exploits:** The Cisco PSIRT is not aware of any public announcements or malicious use of the vulnerability that is described in this advisory.

Affected:
- Cisco / Cisco IOS XR Software: affected 7.0.1; affected 7.1.1; affected 7.0.90; affected 6.7.1; affected 7.0.2; affected 7.1.15; affected 7.1.2; affected 6.7.2; affected 7.1.25; affected 7.1.3; affected 6.7.3; affected 7.3.1; affected 7.4.1; affected 6.8.1; affected 7.3.2 …(+38 more in JSONL)

A vulnerability in the Object Linking and Embedding, 2nd Generation (OLE2) file parser for ClamAV could allow an unauthenticated, remote attacker to exceed the configured MaxScanTime and cause a DoS condition on an affected device.   This vulnerability is due to inefficiencies when parsing specifically formatted files with the OLE2 file parser. An attacker could exploit this vulnerability by by sending a crafted Microsoft Compound File Binary (CFB) file to be scanned. A successful exploit could allow the attacker to effectively cause the ClamAV OLE2 parser to get into an infinite loop, resulting in a DoS condition on the affected software.

**exploits:** The Cisco PSIRT is not aware of any public announcements or malicious use of the vulnerabilities that are described in this advisory.

- **CISA KEV**: added 2026-10-14, ransomware=Unknown — Cisco Secure Email Gateway Relative Path Traversal Vulnerability

A vulnerability in the Advanced Malware Protection (AMP) feature of Cisco Secure Email Gateway could allow an unauthenticated, remote attacker to write arbitrary files on the underlying operating system.

This vulnerability is due to improper handling of email attachments when the file reputation service is enabled. An attacker could exploit this vulnerability by sending an email that contains a crafted attachment through an affected device. A successful exploit could allow the attacker to write arbitrary files and execute commands with&nbsp;root privileges on the underlying operating system.

**exploits:** In October 2026, the Cisco PSIRT became aware of active exploitation of this vulnerability.

### CVE-2026-76524 — Open Source Snort 3 Control Channel Socket Aribitrary Command Execution Vulnerability
- Assigner: cisco | Published: 2026-10-21 | Updated: 2026-10-22 | Max CVSS: 7.8
- CWE: CWE-306 Missing Authentication for Critical Function
- CVSS 3.1 (cna): 7.8 HIGH `CVSS:3.1/AV:L/AC:L/PR:L/UI:N/S:U/C:H/I:H/A:H`
- SSVC (CISA-ADP): Exploitation=none, Automatable=no, Technical Impact=total

A vulnerability in the control channel socket implementation of&nbsp;Open Source Snort 3 could allow an authenticated, local attacker with low privileges to execute arbitrary commands as the Snort 3 process user.

This vulnerability is due to a lack of authentication when a local user connects to the Snort control channel socket. An attacker could exploit this vulnerability by connecting to the Snort 3 control channel socket as a local user. A successful exploit could allow the attacker to execute arbitrary commands as well as read and write Snort 3 process memory.

**exploits:** The Cisco PSIRT is not aware of any public announcements or malicious use of the vulnerability that is described in this advisory.

Affected:
- Cisco / Cisco Open Source Snort3: affected 3.12.2.0; affected 3.1.2.0; affected 3.1.3.0; affected 3.1.4.0; affected 3.1.5.0; affected 3.1.6.0; affected 3.1.7.0; affected 3.1.8.0; affected 3.1.9.0; affected 3.1.10.0; affected 3.1.12.0; affected 3.1.13.0; affected 3.1.14.0; affected 3.1.15.0; affected 3.1.16.0 …(+90 more in JSONL)
